form:FormGroup.helpText: A disabled policy is kept, but grants nothing.

form:FormGroup.label: Name
form:FormGroup.helpText: A name for the policy, unique among tool policies.

form:FormGroup.label: Categories
form:FormGroup.helpText: The categories of Stroom's tools the policy grants, in the 'Ask Stroom AI' chat and over MCP, each either Read-only (only the tools and calls that cannot change anything) or Read and write. A user gets the tools of every enabled policy that covers them; with none, they get no tools. A policy only narrows: each tool still checks the user's other permissions.
